newsitem.title: USA: France says G7 against Russia as full member.
newsitem.headline: France says G7 against Russia as full member.

text.p: France said on Friday there was a consensus among the Group of Seven industrialized nations against full membership in the exclusive club for Russia.

"There is a consensus among the Group of Seven rich nations that they need to continue meeting without Russia to discuss economic and financial issues," said a spokeswoman for French President Jacques Chirac.
Spokeswoman Catherine Colonna told a news conference: "The consensus among the seven countries is that we should retain the G7 for dealing with certain questions."
She said she was referring to "all economic and financial questions."
Russia has been accepted in all G7 meetings during this weekend's three-day summit except for a one-hour session on economic and financial matters on Saturday.
President Bill Clinton earlier on Friday declared with Yeltsin at his side that Russia was "fully included" in the G7 and referred to a "Group of Eight."
